Lint rejected control-code regexes and generated `{}` for no-arg RPC; used explicit character checks and generated Record<string,never>, then passed. Manual fixture review added provider_id (trusted schema shape), populated unit data to avoid a vacuous denied-read test, and tested repeat linkage; final SQL suite passed. No relaxed authorization was used to fix checks.
